en: A black‑and‑white riverside view with wooden bathing houses or floating cabins moored along the shore and small boats nearby. A tree‑lined embankment and walkway run along the right side of the image. The scene is quiet and rural, with low buildings visible across the river. The caption at the top reads "Daugavpils. Peldētavas." and there is a small number "20." at the top right. In the lower right corner, faint text reads "Zudusī Latvija."
